clay-600.note: Accent as text on sand (5.9:1 on sand-50, 5.6:1 on sand-100, 4.5:1 on sand-200).

dusk-line.note: Decorative only; fails 3:1 non-text, never the only edge of a control.

glow.note: Canvas uses RGB triplets core 255,246,226 / halo 255,200,120.

muted.note: 5.5:1 on sand-100, 4.4:1 on sand-200: muted text sits on sand-100 or lighter.

display.purpose: Hero tagline in Pinyon Script, dusk-title, under the wordmark.

script.purpose: Two to four words: section names, script month, step numerals. Pinyon Script stands in for Edwardian Script ITC (unlicensed).

title.purpose: Rail card names, event title; Coming soon headings at 1.5rem/350.

lead.purpose: Sub-copy, hero lead, about statement and step text in Fraunces 350.

label.purpose: Coming soon label, rail hint; sentence case, +0.04em.

shadows.name: event-lift

shadows.name: inset-ring
shadows.purpose: Borders drawn as rings: ghost button, toggles, menu button (22–30%).

shadows.name: tile-ring

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for transforms, fades, entrances, hero settle.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Arrow nudge, nav underline, menu icon.

motion.name: woodsprite-spring
motion.value: stiffness 7–16 /s², damping 0.72 × critical; layers {scale .45/.75/1.1, alpha .45/.7/1, drift .35/.6/1, k ×.5/.8/1}
motion.purpose: Damped follow of pointer and attract-to-primary; idle after 3.5s; reduced motion renders one still frame.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: entrance → 300ms fade; hero settle, staggered transitions and sprite loop off

Cine suntem

Suntem trei prietene care cred că mâinile știu uneori lucruri pe care mintea încă nu le-a spus.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Light on Sand"**

One world taken straight from the AVA logo: dark-brown line drawing on sand, warmed by a diffuse light that runs from umber through clay to beige, and glowing motes (the "woodsprites") that drift and softly follow the visitor. The home page is an evening at the workshop table: it opens in umber dusk under a full-bleed warm photograph of hands in clay, then lifts through a dawn band into sand as the visitor reads. Elegance comes from restraint and from the type trio (Fraunces for the voice, Jost for the information, Pinyon Script for a handful of handwritten words), not from ornament.

The page runs in four bands: dusk (hero, about, services rail, steps) on `umber-900 → umber-800 → umber-700`; a dawn band `umber-700 → clay-400 → sand-200`; sand (the next event, the Coming soon pair, the newsletter) on `sand-200 → sand-100`; and an `umber-900` footer. Every gap in content is shown honestly with the "În curând / Coming soon" pattern; nothing is invented to fill the layout. Motion is damped and physical, never snapped; bright light is reserved for what moves or is actionable.

Directions A Liniște and C Jurnal were shown and not chosen (2026-10-17); see design/directions/.
keyCharacteristics: Dark brown on sand, from the logo; one warm earth ramp, no second hue.
Dusk first, lifting to sand: umber bands above, a dawn band, sand below, umber footer.
Fraunces at light weights (300–400), Jost body, Pinyon Script for the hero tagline and a few words.
Pill-shaped actions with a circular arrow well; soft, large radii elsewhere.
Diffuse gradient light and additive woodsprite motes as the only "effects".
Honest "Coming soon" placeholders instead of invented content.
Romanian first (ș, ț with comma below), English as a full second version.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from the sand–clay–umber ramp, the ink pair or the dusk tier. There is no second hue; warmth and depth come from moving along the ramp, never from adding a colour.

rules.name: The Clay Text Rule
rules.body: `clay-500` passes only 3.5:1 on `sand-100` and 2.9:1 on `sand-200`, so accent text on sand uses `clay-600` (≥ 4.5:1 down to `sand-200`). `clay-500` stays for non-text marks.

rules.name: The Surface Tier Rule
rules.body: Text colour is set by surface tier tokens (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--fg-2`, `--fg-3`, `--line`), and dusk surfaces re-declare the whole tier. Components read the tier, never a raw hex, so the same component works on sand and on dusk.

rules.name: The Dusk Tier Rule
rules.body: Dusk surfaces (`umber-700` to `umber-900`, the hero veil, the date panel, the footer) use only the dusk tier: `dusk-fg`, `dusk-fg-2`, `dusk-fg-3`, `dusk-accent`, `dusk-title` and `dusk-line`. No other light hex is set on dusk, and ink-tier colours never appear there.

rules.name: The Few Words Rule
rules.body: Pinyon Script is for two to four words at a time (the hero tagline, a section name, a month, a step numeral). Never body, never buttons, never a full sentence.

rules.name: The Light Voice Rule
rules.body: Fraunces runs at 300–400. Emphasis comes from size and italic, not weight; 500 belongs to Jost (buttons, labels, links).

rules.name: The Comma-Below Rule
rules.body: Romanian copy uses ș and ț with comma below (U+0219, U+021B), never the cedilla forms. Every face in the trio must render them; check any replacement script face before adopting it.

rules.name: The Light Is Reserved Rule
rules.body: Bright, moving light belongs to what moves or is actionable: motes gather at the primary action, nowhere else. Static surfaces may carry only diffuse, low-alpha radial light baked into their background (the hero's top-right warmth, the date panel's corner); never glows, blooms or lens effects on text, cards or images.

rules.name: The Still Reading Plane Rule
rules.body: Text and cards stay put; only the light layer drifts. Content never parallaxes.

dos: **Do** use the "În curând / Coming soon" pattern for every missing testimonial, photo, price, date, retreat detail or legal datum; show only facts from the client's content document.

**Do** keep primary actions in `ink` pills with the arrow well and `data-glow` (inverted to `sand-50` on dusk), at most one filled button per group, the ghost pill beside it for the second door ("Pentru companii").

**Do** hold text on sand to `ink`, `ink-soft`, `muted` or `clay-600`, and text on dusk to the dusk tier; keep every text pair at WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large) and recheck when a gradient stop sits behind text.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` for every animation, including the woodsprite canvas (still frame, no follow).
**Do** write Romanian with comma-below ș and ț, and test every font (especially the script) with them.
**Do** draw borders as 1px inset rings or hairlines (`line` on sand, `dusk-line` on dusk), and use `rounded.pill` for anything clickable that is not a card.
donts: **Don't** invent testimonials, prices, dates, client logos or photos, and don't fill content gaps with decoration.
**Don't** set Pinyon Script for more than a few words, for body text, buttons or labels.
**Don't** introduce a hue outside the sand–clay–umber ramp, use `clay-500` for text on sand (use `clay-600`), or set a light hex on dusk that is not in the dusk tier.
**Don't** put glows, blooms or motion on static text, cards or images; bright light belongs to the motes and the primary action, and static surfaces get only diffuse radial light.
**Don't** use hard or dark neutral shadows; the one shadow is long, soft and umber-tinted.
**Don't** ship the bottom review switcher pill (A · Liniște / B · Amurg / C · Jurnal); it is mockup chrome for the client review, not part of the site.
